cp stdout $WORK/want.txt
stdout '^c128: hit=13 miss=false negzero=0 nan=false len=5$'

stdout '^t128-order: \(-4\+5i\),\(0\+0i\),\(1\+1i\),\(1\+2i\),\(1\+3i\),\(2\+2i\),\(3\+3i\),\(4\+0i\),\(6-7i\),\(9\+9i\),$'

logos eject -o ../eject_out
exists ../eject_out/main.go
cd ../eject_out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
cd ../consumer
cd ..

-- consumer/go.mod --
module example.com/cmcomplex

go 1.27

-- consumer/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
)

const c128 = map[complex128]int{1 + 2i: 12, 1 + 3i: 13, 3 - 4i: 34, complex(5, 6): 56, 0 + 0i: 0}

const c64 = map[complex64]string{1 + 2i: "a", 1 + 3i: "b", complex(7, -8): "c"}

const t128 = map[complex128]int{complex(1, 1): 11, complex(1, 2): 12, complex(1, 3): 13, complex(2, 2): 22, complex(3, 3): 33, complex(-4, 5): 45, complex(6, -7): 67, complex(0, 0): 0, complex(9, 9): 99, complex(4, 0): 40}

const t64 = map[complex64]int{complex(1, 1): 11, complex(1, 2): 12, complex(1, 3): 13, complex(2, 2): 22, complex(3, 3): 33, complex(-4, 5): 45, complex(6, -7): 67, complex(0, 0): 0, complex(0.1, 0.2): 102, complex(0.1, 0.3): 103}

func probe128(nz float64, nan float64) {
	cv, cok := c128[1+3i]
	_, mok := c128[9+9i]
	zv, zok := c128[complex(nz, nz)]
	_, nok := c128[complex(nan, 1)]
	fmt.Printf("c128: hit=%d miss=%v negzero=%d nan=%v len=%d\n", cv, mok, zv, nok, len(c128))
	_ = cok
	_ = zok
}

func probe64() {
	cv, cok := c64[1+3i]
	_, mok := c64[0+0i]
	fmt.Printf("c64: hit=%s miss=%v len=%d\n", cv, mok, len(c64))
	_ = cok
}

func probeTables(nz float64) {
	cv, cok := t128[complex(-4, 5)]
	_, mok := t128[8+8i]
	zv, zok := t128[complex(nz, 0)]
	fmt.Printf("t128: hit=%d miss=%v negzero=%d len=%d\n", cv, mok, zv, len(t128))
	_ = cok
	_ = zok
	gv, gok := t64[complex(0.1, 0.3)]
	_, gmok := t64[complex(8, 8)]
	fmt.Printf("t64: hit=%d miss=%v len=%d\n", gv, gmok, len(t64))
	_ = gok
}

func probeOrder() {
	fmt.Print("c128-order: ")
	for k := range c128 {
		fmt.Printf("%v,", k)
	}
	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Print("t128-order: ")
	for k := range t128 {
		fmt.Printf("%v,", k)
	}
	fmt.Println()
}

func main() {
	nz := math.Copysign(0, -1)
	probe128(nz, math.NaN())
	probe64()
	probeTables(nz)
	probeOrder()
}
